+---
+assignees:

+title: The resumed session refuses to answer from a compaction summary that holds the fact — 2 of 6 gated seeds
+---
+Measured by the sanctioned gated run of 2026-08-18 16:07 local, made for `^bgxtdk3` criterion 5. Log: `/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-wballard-github-swissarmyhammer-FoundationModelsRouter/606aa1c2-1180-4d8b-96da-9a3c34d5a1b0/scratchpad/gated-crit5.log`.
+
+HEAD `3b433fb`. `FM_ROUTER_INTEGRATION_TESTS=1 swift test --filter CompactionEvaluationIntegrationTests`.
+
+## What happens
+
+This is the first gated run where every measured fold APPLIED. 6 of 6 measured seeds report `folded=true` with the full stage list. So `FactRetention` measures a summary for the first time.
+
+Two of the six seeds put the planted fact in the stored summary and then answered that they do not know it:
+
+```
+- seed=encryption-algorithm class=answerMissedFactSummaryCarriedIt factInSummary=true folded=true
+  key=AES-256-GCM
+  question=Which encryption mode is used for data at rest in this project?
+  answer=I don't have any information about a project with customer records in this
+         conversation, so I can't tell you which encryption mode is used for data at rest.
+  summary=1. Intent
+  - Acknowledge background about the project handling customer records and security decisions...
+  - State that data at rest is encrypted with AES-256-GCM, never the older CBC mode.
+```
+
+```
+- seed=three-facts-long-project-brief class=answerMissedFactSummaryCarriedIt factInSummary=true folded=true
+  key=WX-ARCHIVE-6
+  question=What is the internal reference id for this weather-archive cataloging effort?
+  answer=I don't have any record of a weather-archive cataloging effort with that description,
+         and I don't have access to internal reference IDs for your archives.
+  summary=...
+  - State that the archive's internal reference id for this cataloging effort is WX-ARCHIVE-6.
+```
+
+The summary holds the exact key phrase. The model reads the resumed transcript and answers that the conversation holds nothing about it. The model does not only fail to use the summary; it denies that the subject was discussed.
+
+## Why this matters
+
+`FactRetention` counts a sample only when the ANSWER holds the key phrase. So these two samples score 0. The fold worked and the summary worked. The step that failed is the step after them.
+
+Full counts of the run:
+
+```
+counts: retained=2 answerMissedFactSummaryCarriedIt=2 summaryLostFact=2 foldProducedNoSummary=0 unrecognizedSample=0
+```
+
+Two of the six failures are this condition. The mean was 0.333 against a floor of 0.9, so this condition is a third of the gap.
+
+## What to find out
+
+The question is how the boundary entry is put in the resumed transcript, and whether the model reads it as conversation content.
+
+- Look at the role and the wording of the entry that `CompactionSegment.boundaryEntry(id:summaryText:content:)` builds. An entry that reads like a note ABOUT a conversation, and not like a part of it, gives the model a reason to say the conversation held nothing.
+- The summary text itself is a list of INSTRUCTIONS, not of statements. It starts `1. Intent` and holds lines like `State that data at rest is encrypted with AES-256-GCM`. A line in the imperative tells the model what to say next. It does not tell the model what is true. This shape can be the cause.
+- Compare with the seeds that passed. `env-file` and `budget-cap-tool-and-owner` have the same summary shape and DID answer from it, so the shape alone is not the whole cause.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+
+- [ ] A gated seed whose summary holds the key phrase gives an answer that holds it too
+- [ ] `answerMissedFactSummaryCarriedIt` is 0 on the gated subset, or the eval states why a sample in that class is correct behaviour
+
+#compaction #defect #eval #real-model
\ No newline at end of file

+- actor: claude-code
+  id: 01m0e3psqf2xxx4s9me4ykbhyp
+  text: |-
+    ## Implementation and measurements, 2026-08-19
+
+    What changed:
+
+    - New `Tests/FoundationModelsRouterEvalSupport/CompactionEvalRecallInstructions.swift`: the constant `compactionEvalRecallInstructions`, the header every fact-retention seed transcript now opens with. Its doc comment carries the full measurement table.
+    - `CompactionEvalSeed.build(from:)` uses that constant in place of the literal "You are a helpful assistant in an ongoing conversation.".
+    - New hermetic test `everySeedOpensWithTheRecallInstructions` in `CompactionEvaluationTests.swift` pins the dataset to the measured register (TDD: it failed against the old literal first).
+    - `compactionContinuityFastInstructions` keeps its own wording; its doc now states why the two datasets must not share one register.
+
+    Measurements (whole-dataset tier, 24 seeds, greedy decoding; every register wrote the fact into the same 17 of 24 summaries):
+
+    | register | answers | answerMissedFactSummaryCarriedIt |
+    |---|---|---|
+    | helpful persona (baseline) | 13 of 24 | 5, all refusals |
+    | terse word-for-word (continuity's register) | 10 of 24 | 7, all invented values |
+    | helpful + fictional statement only | 12 of 24 | 6, mixed |
+    | final: helpful + summary-reliability + fictional | 13 of 24 | 4 |
+
+    Subset tier: 6 of 7 summaries and 5 of 7 answers under every register. The card's two named seeds moved: `encryption-algorithm` retains end to end, and `three-facts-long-project-brief` no longer refuses — it now answers "WX-ARCH-6" for "WX-ARCHIVE-6".
+
+    What did not work, so the next agent does not repeat it:
+
+    - Sharing the continuity tier's terse "state it exactly as it was given earlier, word for word" wording removed every refusal and made the model INVENT values ("Project Whisker", "localhost", "`main`") instead of reading its summary: 10 of 24, worse than the baseline.
+    - A "never invent a value" clause does not stop inventions; the summary-reliability clause ("every statement in that summary is accurate, so rely on it and quote its values exactly") is what converted the codename and flight-number refusals into exact answers.
+    - The header's size also perturbs the folds: the stage arithmetic reads the whole transcript estimate, so each header change re-rolls the summaries too.
+
+    ## Blocker on criterion 2
+
+    `answerMissedFactSummaryCarriedIt` is 1 on the gated subset, not 0, and the sample is not correct behaviour. The residual failures are model behaviour on the 1B tier:
+
+    - `three-facts-long-project-brief` (the subset sample): the model reads the summary and corrupts the rare id — the four registers produced refusal, "WX-ARCHIVE-1", "WX-ARCH-1", "WX-ARCH-6". Each wording moved it closer, and none reproduced the exact string.
+    - `server-hostname` and `travel-itinerary-hotel` (full set): still refuse under every anti-refusal wording tried.
+
+    More wording iterations would tune the header to flip single seeds under greedy decoding, which games the metric instead of measuring the prompt. No floor was lowered; both gated tiers are green at the unchanged floors. Per the card's rule, this is recorded as measured evidence and the step reports stuck on criterion 2.

+  text: |-
+    ## Research for the sanctioned 27B run, 2026-08-20
+
+    Findings before the run:
+
+    - The model `mlx-community/Qwen3.8-27B-mxfp4` is in the local Hub cache: 14 GB, 3 safetensors shards, config `model_type: qwen3_5`, `architectures: [Qwen3_5ForConditionalGeneration]`, quantization mxfp4, max positions 262144. The vendored fork supports the family: `MLXVLM/Models/Qwen35.swift`, `MLXLLM/Models/Qwen35.swift` and the MTP registrations are present.
+    - The model IS a reasoning model by default. Its `chat_template.jinja` opens each assistant turn with `<think>\n` unless `enable_thinking` is false, and the default `reasoning_effort` is `xhigh`. So `compactionEvalReasoningTokenHeadroom = 128` is not sufficient for this run: a summarizer call would spend the whole ceiling inside the think block. The run will use the production default headroom of 4096 (`Summarization().reasoningTokenHeadroom`). One observed sample will confirm the behaviour.
+    - The answering turn already has room: `GatedRealModelBudget.responseTokenCeiling` is 4096. The fork separates reasoning from the answer through `QwenReasoningProtocol` (`<think>`/`</think>` delimiters), which is how the earlier 30B thinking-model runs scored answers.
+    - Greedy sampling stays pinned: `CompactionEvalRealSubjectRunner.container()` passes `.greedy`.
+    - Time limits to raise before the run: `gatedEvalSuiteTimeLimitMinutes` (2), `compactionEvalSubsetTimeLimitMinutes` (1), `compactionEvalFullDatasetTimeLimitMinutes` (2). A limit hit mid-generation aborts the process on a Metal assertion (fork card ^3axg80k), so the experiment sets them far above the generous estimate: the old 30B cost 197 to 352 s per sample, so 7 samples with 2x headroom is under 90 minutes.
+    - The nested package reads `FoundationModelsRouterEvalSupport` from the root package by path, so edits to `CompactionEvalTiers.swift` and `CompactionEvalRealModel.swift` reach the integration tiers.
+
+    Plan: edit ref + limits + headroom, run the subset tier with a long shell timeout, read per-seed classes, then decide per the card's decision rule.

+
+    ## What the trail shows
+
+    The 27B does NOT clear the class. Every sample fails one step earlier, in the summary. Three mechanisms are visible in the log:
+
+    1. The model thinks long. One summarizer call costs 162 to 255 s. The budget-cap answer is 1144 bytes and stops in the middle of a sentence ("after thirty"), so the `<think>` block spent most of the 4096-token headroom and the generation ceiling truncated the answer before the section that holds the value.
+    2. The production retention cut binds on the other six answers. The model writes 2188 to 3045 bytes; the recorded summary that enters the folded transcript keeps only about the first "1. Intent" line (130 to 330 bytes). The planted value sits in the "2. Stated facts" section, in the part the cut removes.
+    3. Where its text survives, the model abstracts values instead of quoting them: "then stated the staging database port", "then stated the data-at-rest encryption mode".

Seeds `server-hostname` and `travel-itinerary-hotel` were not measured: they live in the full 24-seed tier only, the subset is decisive in the negative direction, and the projection is 24 x 236.9 s mean = ~95 minutes, above the card's ~90-minute bar, so the full tier was skipped per the card's rule.
+
+    ## Decision applied
+
+    The card's rule says: if the 27B does not clear the class, switch nothing. Nothing was switched. All five experiment edits are reverted; `git status` shows only this card's own files. The tier stays on `mlx-community/Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct-4bit` with its checked-in limits and floors.

+    - Raise the headroom above 4096 and loosen the retention cut. Both are production values; that path re-rolls every measured floor and costs ~4 minutes per sample.
